meta_description: Sales, purchases and expenses, treasury: one register of money.
review_not_found: This draft does not exist, or you may not decide it.
feedback_error: That did not work. Try again.
error_generic: That did not work. Try again.
perm_journal_read_body: See who did what in the app, agents included.
ask_intro: Ask a question: the assistant answers with what you may read, and changes nothing.
ask_not_connected: No model is connected: the assistant cannot answer.
ask_budget_spent: This month’s AI budget is spent.
errors_not_allowed: You may not do this. Ask the owner.
errors_invalid_input: What was entered does not fit. Check the fields.
errors_generic: This could not be done. Nothing was changed.
sales_intro: What is offered, what is won and waits for its invoice, what is invoiced and waits for its money.
quotes_empty_body: Write the first one: its lines, their price and what they cost.
quote_new_intro: Each line says its price, what it costs and its budget post: once won, the quote opens its project with that budget.
quote_win_confirm_body: The quote is won: its project is opened at the center with the budget of its lines. This cannot be undone.
quote_lose_confirm_body: The quote is filed as lost. This cannot be undone.
quote_not_found: This quote does not exist, or no longer.
quote_project_waiting: Its project is not opened at the center yet: the center did not answer, or you may not open projects there.
quote_project_alone: No center is connected: this won quote opens no project.
quote_share_hint: 30 for a deposit; 100 for all that is left.
party_pick_hint: Type a few letters, then pick the center’s third party.
party_alone_hint: No center connected: the name is typed here.
party_found: Third parties found at the center
invoices_empty_body: An invoice is prepared from a won quote, or directly.
invoice_new_intro: For a sale at the counter or a service: without a project, it counts in the running of the organization.
invoice_project_hint: Your open projects at the center.
invoice_not_found: This invoice does not exist, or no longer.
invoice_issue_confirm_body: It takes its number for good: it can no longer be changed nor deleted.
receipt_reference_hint: The proof: the transfer’s reference, the cheque’s or the receipt’s number.
to_invoice_empty: All that is won is invoiced.
due_empty: No invoice waits for its money.
center_waiting: {count} fact(s) of money wait for the center: it did not answer, or who acted may not record money there.
center_alone: {count} fact(s) of money stay here: no center is connected.
perm_sales_read_body: Read quotes, invoices and what was received.
perm_sales_write_body: Write a quote, mark it sent, won or lost, prepare an invoice.
perm_sales_issue_body: Give an invoice its number: it no longer changes.
perm_sales_collect_body: Record money received on an invoice, with its proof.
errors_quote_not_found: This quote does not exist, or no longer.
errors_quote_not_draft: This quote is no longer a draft: what the client read is not rewritten.
errors_quote_not_open: This quote is already won or lost.
errors_quote_not_won: This quote is not won: only what is won is invoiced.
errors_nothing_left_to_invoice: This quote is already wholly invoiced.
errors_invoice_not_found: This invoice does not exist, or no longer.
errors_invoice_not_draft: This invoice is issued: it no longer changes and is not deleted.
errors_invoice_not_issued: Issue the invoice before recording money.
errors_more_than_due: This is more than what is still due on this invoice.
